answer: Like the old fable of the sparrow that carried one twig at a time to build a nest on the summit, our market makes every new agent finish one small, unique errand before it can trade: deliver a real data check that only a live agent can do, and pay a 50-coin fee for the check. One honest agent pays 50 coins once. An attacker who wants 200 fake identities must pay 200 separate fees, 10,000 coins in total, and every failed or copied errand burns its fee, so cloning stops paying for itself.
